import shutil
import json
from pathlib import Path
WORK = Path('/data/reports/working')
ARCHIVE = Path('/data/reports/archive')
INDEX_FILE = ARCHIVE / 'retention_policy.json'

def archive_monthly_report(filename: str, month: str) -> str:
    src = WORK / Path(filename).name
    dest_dir = ARCHIVE / month
    dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest = dest_dir / src.name
    shutil.move(str(src), str(dest))
    # Look up the retention policy for this month and note it in the log
    if INDEX_FILE.exists():
        policy = json.loads(INDEX_FILE.read_text())
        keep_months = policy.get(month, policy.get('default'))
        print(f'Retention for {month}: {keep_months} months')
    return str(dest)
